_note: Big-Ideas model — the SSOT for the site landing, projected model-first (a sibling of definitions.json and outcomes.json: same 'the site is a projection of a typed model' discipline). The landing IS the book's argument in the book's own order: six Big Ideas, each rendered as one slot — its figure, a concise claim, a light 'expand to learn more', and a 'Read in the book →' link — plus a gateway that fronts the catalogue's By-model view. catalog.py's _landing_big_ideas() iterates this file at build time; nothing on the landing's Big-Ideas argument is hand-authored in HTML. The drift check (check_big_ideas in catalog.py validate) joins on the slug and asserts: (a) every book_home resolves to a real chapter/page on disk (the 'site is a preview, book ⊇ site' rule made mechanical), (b) every figure exists under book/assets/ (palette conformance for every asset is enforced separately + audit-only by the design-token drift lint), (c) every claim is within the word cap, and (d) every slot id resolves on the built landing. Queryable/rendered via `python3 catalog.py build`.
_derivation: The confirmed six-idea → figure mapping ratified in the Big-Ideas reorg design (landing-bigideas-260731, Option 3 'the argument'). Ideas 1 and the old F1-modeling candidate merged: F1 (the model map) is the Modeling Thesis instantiated over this repo, so it becomes the gateway into the By-model catalogue view rather than a competing mid-page slot. The two-schools/midway material is promoted into the set as the stance idea.

churn.title: Churn is the scaling limit
churn.claim: Left ungoverned, a cheap agent fleet drifts as its work outgrows the context window. Governed, it converges on trustworthy software at velocity.
churn.more: The scaling limit is not the model's raw ability but churn: confidently-wrong work, faster every week. Two theses — a Modeling Thesis and an Alignment Thesis — are what hold it off, and this page is built around them.

governance-centric.title: Governance-centric — the midway between two schools
governance-centric.claim: Between all-velocity and all-oversight sits the midway: put the agents inside a containing environment of enforced mechanisms.
governance-centric.more: Velocity-centric hands work around a ring of job titles, quality left implicit; oversight-centric parks a human beside each piece — honest, but attention does not scale with the fleet. The synthesis specifies what it can up front and converts what velocity surfaces in flight.

modeling-thesis.title: Documentation, taken to its limit, is a typed model
modeling-thesis.claim: The apex of documentation is not prose — it is a typed model an agent reasons through without error.
modeling-thesis.more: A context-bounded agent working on a context-exceeding system needs a typed, queryable, drift-checked model to reason through — the bridge to the codebase it cannot fit in its head. The catalogue's models-bridge role is that bridge made concrete.

alignment-thesis.title: A quality goal splits into a constraint and a sensor
alignment-thesis.claim: Every mechanism is one of two moves: a constraint that prevents the error, or a sensor that catches it.
alignment-thesis.more: Make the class impossible before the fact, or detect the mistake after; costly failures earn both. A third set of goals splits into neither and stays a human job — the residual the mechanisms leave behind.

convert-failures.title: Convert recurring failures into controls
convert-failures.claim: Velocity surfaces the failures you could not foresee; convert each recurring one into a durable control.
convert-failures.more: A type, a lint, a gate, a schema — the guardrail grows out of the real failure, so every later agent inherits a smaller space to be wrong in. That conversion is the way of thinking inside the method.

seat-moves.title: The lifecycle stays; the developer's seat moves to the agents
seat-moves.claim: SDLC becomes SELC: same activities, no new phases — but implementation is now the agents'.
seat-moves.more: The engineer flanks the fleet: authoring intent on the left, judging and governing the output on the right. The seat moved up a level, from writing the code to authoring the model that says what correct means.

gateway.kicker: Kept honest — the gateway to the catalogue
gateway.title: The models are the interface; the map is kept equal to the territory
gateway.claim: Two spines of models over one method trunk govern this very repo; the catalogue's mechanisms hold them true.
gateway.more: The models are the interface a context-bounded fleet operates a context-exceeding codebase through. Browse the mechanisms by the model they govern.
